last_access_message: Windows on this computer records when files are last opened, so this check updated the last-access time of the files and folders it read. It changed nothing else about them.
absence_note: Not found does not mean AI was not used. Cleared browser history, private (InPrivate or Incognito) windows, another browser or Windows account, a phone or another computer leave nothing here for LUMINOL to find, and LUMINOL cannot tell whether history was cleared.

hold_notice.text:
AI PRESERVATION NOTICE - DRAFT FOR COUNSEL TO ADAPT
Prepared from a LUMINOL check of this computer on 13 October 2026 (Windows account shown as %USERPROFILE%).
Until you are told otherwise in writing, preserve all information created with or by AI tools, including the following found on this computer:
1. Claude (web): Do not clear site data for claude.ai.
2. ChatGPT / Codex agent: Do not delete, archive or clear agent threads in the Codex app, and keep the %USERPROFILE%\.codex folder as it is.
3. Windows: Do not clear Windows notifications. Do not delete or move files downloaded from AI sites (Downloads, Desktop, Documents). Do not clear Windows' list of recently opened files.
4. ChatGPT desktop app: Do not delete or clear the app's log folders (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Codex\Logs and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\OpenAI.Codex_*\LocalCache\Local\Codex\Logs). Keep the ChatGPT desktop app installed. Do not update, reset or sign out of it until its folder (%USERPROFILE%\.codex) is preserved.
5. Claude Code: Do not delete Claude Code transcripts (%USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects). Preserve them before automatic deletion can remove them.
6. Web browsers: Do not clear browsing history, cookies or site data in any browser profile on this computer.
7. Gemini (Google account): Do not delete Gemini Apps Activity or shorten its auto-delete period. Export it with Google Takeout now.
8. Claude account (Anthropic servers): Do not delete Claude conversations or projects, change privacy settings, or close the account. Request an account export now.
9. ChatGPT account (OpenAI servers): Do not delete or archive ChatGPT chats, use Temporary Chat, change Data controls, or close the account. Request an account export now.
10. Claude desktop app: Keep the Claude desktop app installed. Do not reset, sign out of or uninstall it.
11. Cursor: Do not reset Cursor or clear its chat or agent history.
12. VS Code AI agents (Cline, Roo, Kilo): Do not remove the VS Code AI agent extensions or clear their task history.
13. Local AI (Ollama, LM Studio, GPT4All, Jan, AnythingLLM): Do not delete local AI apps, their models or their saved chats.
14. ChatGPT (web): Do not clear site data for chatgpt.com.
Records may disappear while this notice is in effect:
Claude (web) - claude.ai storage inside the browser: recent activity may disappear within about 11 hours. (Lab measurement).
Windows - Windows notifications from AI apps: lasts about 2.4 to 3.9 days. (Lab measurement).
ChatGPT desktop app - App log files: oldest item reaches the 14-day reference window in about 14 days. (Lab measurement).
Claude Code - Claude Code session transcripts: oldest item reaches the 30-day reference window in about 30 days. (Vendor policy).
Web browsers - AI sites in browser history: reference window: about 90 days. (Vendor policy).
Gemini (Google account) - Gemini Apps Activity in the Google account: account activity follows its auto-delete setting; see vendor exceptions. (Vendor policy).
Claude account (Anthropic servers) - Chats stored in the Claude account: vendor describes a 30-day deletion window; see stated exceptions. (Vendor policy).
ChatGPT account (OpenAI servers) - Chats stored in the ChatGPT account: vendor describes a 30-day deletion window; see stated exceptions. (Vendor policy).
ChatGPT (web) - chatgpt.com storage inside the browser: not a reliable source of chat text. (Lab measurement).
ChatGPT desktop app - Prompt history kept by the ChatGPT desktop app: present after 15 days in the cited lab run. (Lab measurement).
Windows - Files downloaded from AI sites: the download mark may remain while the file stays in place. (System design).
Windows - Recently opened files list: present after 15 days in the cited lab run. (Lab measurement).
A preservation notice cannot stop automatic deletion: collect these items promptly.
Also preserve AI tools and accounts used on other devices (phones, home computers) and anything not listed here: this check covers this Windows account on this computer.
Do not change retention or auto-delete settings, delete, reset or uninstall anything listed without written instructions from counsel.
This notice is a draft for your counsel to adapt.

clock.headline: Oldest item reaches the 30-day reference window in about 30 days

evidence.why: Shows which listed AI site names appear in the browser history files it could read. A match does not prove what a person viewed or said.
evidence.action: Preserve the browser profile; older visits drop off every day.

clock.headline: Reference window: about 90 days
clock.detail: Google's Chrome Help says its History lists the last 90 days. That page does not establish how long a local History file retains every visit; Edge, Brave and Firefox were not separately measured. Today the limit falls on 15 Jul 2026; it moves forward every day.

evidence.evidence: Gemini Apps Activity in the Google account

evidence.action: Check the Gemini Activity auto-delete setting and export with Google Takeout now.

clock.headline: Account activity follows its auto-delete setting; see vendor exceptions
clock.detail: Google says personal Gemini Apps activity auto-deletes after 18 months by default; the setting can be changed. With Keep Activity off, a chat may remain with the account for up to 72 hours. Work accounts differ.

clock.detail: Anthropic says a deleted consumer conversation is removed from back-end storage within 30 days, subject to its stated exceptions. Work and API accounts have separate terms.

cannot_answer: Whether browser history or files were cleared or deleted before this check. A cleared history looks the same to LUMINOL as one with no AI visits. A forensic triage can look for signs of clearing.
What was typed or answered. LUMINOL checks where evidence exists and when it was last changed without reading conversation text.

Other devices (phones, home computers), other Windows accounts, and browsers not used by this Windows account.
Apps and sites not in this version's list.
What an AI agent did through Windows' own records (the file-system change journal and Prefetch). LUMINOL does not inspect these records; an administrator collection may be needed.

lab_note: SAMPLE DATA - generated from a synthetic Windows profile. Lab observations came from one Windows 10 machine in October 2026; each measured item names its tested app version and observation date where recorded. Results may differ on other machines. Vendor windows are subject to the vendor's stated exceptions.

privacy: This report was made on this computer. LUMINOL read file names, sizes and dates, and checked whether AI site names appear in a few files. It did not read conversation text. Windows on this computer records when files are last opened, so this check updated the last-access time of the files and folders it read. It changed nothing else about them. Running the check sent nothing over the internet. If you choose to timestamp this report later, a fingerprint of it is sent (see the .seal.json file).
